title: CE4LOPT
description: Solution methods for counterfactual explanations for linear optimization problems. The repository contains code for the solution methods presented in the following paper: Kurtz, J., Birbil, Ş. İ., & den Hertog, D. (2025). Counterfactual explanations for linear optimization. European Journal of Operational Research.
